record.rationale: Compiler binding for consumed original std::shared_ptr control blocks of actual native Relations/FragmentBaseData, following existing explicit source-native shared-pointer lowering patterns. Callers supply actual new concrete values; no type/default/payload constructor/provider is generated. Empty/copy/move/assign/reset/get/use_count and last-owner actual destructor are explicit within one synchronous realm, with pointer replacement before last old-value destruction. Native atomic/control-block/weak/aliasing/raw-adoption-failure/physical ABI remain unqualified. Native actual relation/path retained copies and context sharing test concrete consumed values, not a fake destructor/provider.
